completion_rule: All F01-F24 implemented and locally verified, full owner inputs delivered; hardware qualification remains a mandatory automatic E0 runtime gate. H01 alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Shared from-scratch architecture
requirements.acceptance: model geometry, paired initialization, declared priors and actual consumer map

requirements.title: Solvable task and label contracts
requirements.acceptance: information sufficiency witnesses, actual environment teacher replay and private-input separation

requirements.title: Full dataset and split closure
requirements.acceptance: required full bundle counts, canonical disjointness, references and offline artifact validation

requirements.title: Complete decision codec
requirements.acceptance: full input/target separation, typed action round trips, no semantic slicing and compatible schemas

requirements.title: Learning algorithms and windows
requirements.acceptance: all registered objectives, correct denominators, gradients, accumulation, optimizer/scaler contracts

requirements.title: Trained decision consumers
requirements.acceptance: actual action/world/value head consumers with shared training representations

requirements.title: Cognitive evidence state
requirements.acceptance: subject/predicate/time support, conflicts, supersession, omission and goal consistency

requirements.title: Bounded planning and execution
requirements.acceptance: composed state conditioning, real imagined transition, monotone counters and termination

requirements.title: Actual controls and metrics
requirements.acceptance: real A/B checkpoint consumers, frozen matched tasks and correct selected forecast joins

requirements.title: Formation and parent lineage
requirements.acceptance: actual E1 arms, paired starts, checkpoint fractions and held-out answer evaluation

requirements.title: Tools and retention
requirements.acceptance: executed tools, independent T0/T1 children, measured replay and protected exclusion

requirements.title: Architecture adaptation
requirements.acceptance: actual S0/S1 handles, zero-gate equivalence, nonzero effects, gradients, masks and restore

requirements.title: Trial authority and evaluation
requirements.acceptance: real binder contract, inherited deadlines, complete query/protected inputs and payload validation

requirements.title: Measured RSI chain
requirements.acceptance: trained P0, fresh archives, independent trained successors and pre-outcome confirmation captures

requirements.title: Allocation and event reduction
requirements.acceptance: one budget across restart, all child attempts/commits charged, phase/iteration caps and exact task schedule

requirements.title: E0 implementation and calibration
requirements.acceptance: full-profile qualification code, complete timing units, pilot charges, frozen protocol and failure refusal

requirements.title: Checkpoint and restart code
requirements.acceptance: complete real payloads, fresh-process load, source/parent consistency and corruption/fencing checks

requirements.title: Statistics and claim logic
requirements.acceptance: paired cluster intervals, registered thresholds, all outcomes and correct RSI attribution

requirements.title: Owner notebook and inputs
requirements.acceptance: pinned source/runtime, actual CLI, prebuilt data, E0-to-full single allocation and checked cells

requirements.title: Complete export
requirements.acceptance: required real payloads, source-bound inventory, restore checks, partial-run reporting and event reconciliation

requirements.title: Evidence-backed build readiness
requirements.acceptance: verify-build implemented, complete local evidence, matching closure and separate runtime qualification gate

requirements.title: Integrated local verification
requirements.acceptance: bounded no-update production rehearsals and relevant regression tests without concealed failures

requirements.title: Published release artifacts
requirements.acceptance: pushed code, full external data artifact, compact manifests, notebook and reproducible environment

requirements.title: Final operator handoff
requirements.acceptance: requirement matrix, verified build report, exact owner commands and no missing implementation

runtime_qualification.criterion: two distinct actual T4 devices, correct worker-local mapping, compatible precision and live allowance
full-profile real gradients/updates and fresh-process exact continuation, within E0 counters/deadline
complete measured update/evaluation costs meet registered minima and fit frozen cases/settings
current allocation, source/data/schema identities and frozen protocol verified by runner
